question: Does fitting the Function yes-line at a stricter false-positive quota bring the held-out-feed false-positive rate to the 0.0025 target, and what coverage does that cost?
one_change: fit the yes-line at quota 0.0015 instead of 0.0025 on out-of-fold scores (same feed-ordered split, same three encoders)

prediction.metric: held-out-feed coverage with the yes-line fitted at false-positive quota 0.0015
prediction.why: T201 at quota 0.0025 gave coverage 0.482 and false positives 0.0033 on held-out feeds; a stricter yes-line should push the false-positive rate under 0.0025 and cost two to nine points of coverage; the sweep also reports quotas 0.0020 and 0.0010
